actual: MA-E16 frozen-prediction 1min TWAP execution-parity canary completed with exit 0 but every day had count=0/deal_amount=0 and ffr/pa/pos=NaN. Runtime evidence showed the minute Exchange had quote_stock_count=0 and quote_df_rows=0. Both active qlib_minute_bin and the named 20260630 minute candidate contain feature/calendar data through 2026-06, but instruments/all.txt still ends at 2026-04-28; the day provider all.txt reaches 2026-06-30. Qlib therefore resolves an empty minute quote universe for the replay window, and the runner publishes a false zero-trade success.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
description: Add a file-only minute-runner preflight that proves the minute quote-universe instrument spans cover the day-provider universe over the requested replay window, including the implicit Qlib all universe. Reject missing/invalid/stale instrument metadata before Qlib init, and reject a non-empty minute pred-backtest that still produces no orders/deals. Preserve suspend/risk policy semantics and the zero-database backtest data plane. Correcting or activating the minute dataset remains a separately reported candidate-data action; this BUG must not overwrite an active dataset.

events.note: Minute provider instruments/all.txt ends at 2026-04-28 while its data and the day universe reach 2026-06. Scope narrowed to qrun file-parity and zero-trade fail-closed guards; candidate dataset correction remains separate from source delivery.

The patched runner loaded in a fresh WSL rdagent-gpu process and rejected the unchanged 2026-06 canary before Qlib init with QE_MINUTE_INSTRUMENT_COVERAGE_MISMATCH: expected=4898 uncovered=4898. The old runner had completed 20/20 dates with count=0 and deal_amount=0.
Workflow changed-file inference classifies scripts/qrun_limit_minute.py as backend-main runtime impact. Runtime fields were corrected without downgrade; restart remains user-owned.

Pre-merge review corrected day-versus-minute membership comparison to trading-date semantics so an instrument beginning at 09:30 on its first eligible day is not falsely rejected, added stable invalid-window handling, and proved non-minute paths remain unchanged.

expected: A minute TWAP run must prove that its minute instrument spans cover the day quote universe throughout the replay window and must fail with a stable reason before backtest when coverage is stale. A non-empty prediction replay that still produces no orders/deals must also fail instead of publishing portfolio metrics as a success.
non_goals: Do not start, stop, or restart any user backend without explicit per-target approval.
